title: EliteReplay: Preserving Diverse Solutions in RL Post-Training via Quality-Diversity Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.22290v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a common post-training technique to improve the accuracy of LLMs on verifiable tasks. However, such training can narrow the set of solutions the model can produce. Several approaches have attempted to address this behavior-sharpening effect, but they often optimize metrics that do not reflect the diversity of correct solutions. Ideally, we want a model that can produce multiple good solutions, not only a single reliable one. We propose EliteReplay, a post-training recipe that pairs GRPO with an "elite" archive built by quality-diversity search. Before training, we use the frozen base model to collect solutions that span distinct approaches; during training, GRPO is combined with a replay loss on this archive. The result is a post-trained model that improves accuracy while preserving more of the base model's solution diversity. On multiple text-to-SQL tasks, EliteReplay achieves a higher pass@128 than all

translated_title: EliteReplay：通过质量-多样性搜索在强化学习后训练中保留多样化解决方案
translated_abstract: 强化学习已成为一种常用的后训练技术，用于提高大语言模型在可验证任务上的准确性。然而，这种训练会缩小模型能够产生的解决方案集合。已有几种方法试图解决这种“行为锐化”效应，但它们通常优化的指标并不能反映正确解决方案的多样性。理想情况下，我们希望模型能够产生多个好的解决方案，而不仅仅是一个可靠的解决方案。我们提出了EliteReplay，这是一种将GRPO与通过质量-多样性搜索构建的“精英”档案库相结合的后训练方法。在训练之前，我们使用冻结的基础模型收集跨越不同方法的解决方案；在训练过程中，GRPO与基于该档案库的回放损失相结合。最终得到的后训练模型在提高准确性的同时，保留了更多基础模型的解决方案多样性。在多个文本到SQL（text-to-SQL）任务上，EliteReplay获得了比所有（对比方法）更高的pass@128。
tldr: 提出EliteReplay后训练方法，将GRPO与基于质量-多样性搜索构建的“精英”档案库的回放损失相结合，使模型在提高准确性的同时保留更多解决方案多样性。
en_tdlr: EliteReplay pairs GRPO with a replay loss on an elite archive built via quality-diversity search, enabling RL post-training to improve accuracy while preserving the base model's solution diversity.
